headlines.text: It was 2020 when the inaugural NWA World Women's Title was crowned as Thunder Rosa vs. Ivelisse went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.16. A fierce, evenly-matched title defense that reportedly turned real at points ? the two exchanged actual shoot-style strikes mid-match, a rare moment of true tension bleeding through the performance, before Rosa retained with a Tombstone piledriver.
It was 2023 when Bill & Starks stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.21 ? a strong outing.

On this day in 2020, Best Friends vs. Proud-N-Powerful fought it out in a Parking Lot Fight match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 8.95 ? a genuine showstealer in a hard-hitting tag team clash. A postponed Parking Lot Fight finally delivered, straight out of the ECW hardcore playbook ? car hoods, steel batons, and a cannonball senton off a windshield, in a rescheduled brawl originally meant for Blood & Guts.
